questions.question: By what title is God addressed at the start of Psalm 80?
options: Mighty King of all glory, the Lord strong in battle
Judge of the nations, who weighs every deed
Maker of heaven and earth, the Lord of hosts
Shepherd of Israel, who leads Joseph like a flock
questions.answer: Shepherd of Israel, who leads Joseph like a flock

questions.question: To what does the psalm compare Israel?
options: A city built upon the hill
A flock led through the wilderness
A vine brought out of Egypt
questions.answer: A vine brought out of Egypt

questions.question: The repeated refrain is, 'Restore us, O God; let your face shine, that we may be saved!'
_____ us, O God; let your face shine, that we may be saved!
You brought a vine out of _____; you drove out the nations and planted it.
